# SyntexLabs Essentials

Essentials is a plugin that provides your server with essential commands every server should have. The Plugin itself is made highly performance so even low-performance servers are able to use this plugin in its fullest extent while still saving resources.

The Plugin comes with following commands and permissions bound to them:

![Commands](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/d10fcc096d24d9fafa5c5f9f7d225e0a0a8f074f.png)
